candidates.description: This feature vector represents sub-word tokens and character fragments from various Indic scripts.
This feature vector represents Hindi interrogative and conditional adverbial markers expressing time, place, and circumstance.
This feature vector represents the anusvara diacritic and nasal consonant clusters in the Devanagari script.
This feature vector represents common suffixes and syllables in Hindi text.
This vector activates for conjunct consonants and specialized phonetic characters in various scripts.
These tokens represent common Hindi vowel modifiers, nasalization markers, and conjunct consonant combinations typical of Devanagari script text.
This vector represents Hindi text fragments, vowel signs, and common inflectional suffixes.
This feature vector represents common Hindi vowel sign characters attached to punctuation marks or commas.
These tokens represent character sequences, subwords, or common graphemes frequently occurring in Hindi text written in the Devanagari script.
These tokens represent fragments and characters of the Devanagari script used for writing Indo-Aryan languages like Hindi and Sanskrit.
